title: OpenAITTSNarration
description: supabase/functions/openai-tts-narration/index.ts. General-purpose TTS for in-app narration (used by OnboardingNarrator.swift) — unlike openai-tts-proxy, the client supplies arbitrary `input` text, capped at 600 characters. Requires sign-in but not a specific entitlement/quota check beyond requireUser in this function (no requireEntitlement/checkQuota call was found in this file, unlike most other proxies — flagged as an asymmetry, not corrected here). Response Content-Type audio/mpeg on success, same binary contract as openai-tts-proxy.

voice.title: OpenAITTSNarrationVoice
voice.description: Defaults to "marin" server-side if omitted (matches Mira's onboarding narrator voice).

input.description: The text to speak. Required and non-empty; rejected with input_required if blank, input_too_long if over 600 chars.

OpenAITTSNarrationSuccessResponse.title: OpenAITTSNarrationSuccessResponse
OpenAITTSNarrationSuccessResponse.description: Raw audio/mpeg byte stream on success — same binary-response note as OpenAITTSProxySuccessResponse.

max.description: Present only alongside error=input_too_long; echoes MAX_CHARS (600).
